L131: # SQL Injection via placeholder confusion with dollar quoted string literals
L132: 
L133: Moderate
L134: 
L135: cite61†jackc published GHSA-j88v-2chj-qfwx Apr 19, 2026
L136: 
L137: ## Package
L138: 
L139: github.com/jackc/pgx (cite71†Go )
L140: 
L141: ## Affected versions
L142: 
L143: < 5.9.2
L144: 
L145: ## Patched versions
L146: 
L147: 5.9.2
L148: 
L149: ## Description
L150: ### Impact
L151: 
L152: SQL injection can occur when:
L153: 
L154:   1. The non-default simple protocol is used.
L155:   2. A dollar quoted string literal is used in the SQL query.
L156:   3. That string literal contains text that would be would be interpreted as a placeholder outside of a string literal.
L157:   4. The value of that placeholder is controllable by the attacker.
L158: 
L159: e.g.
L160: 
L161:     attackValue := `$tag$; drop table canary; --`
L162:     _, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `select $tag$ $1 $tag$, $1`, pgx.QueryExecModeSimpleProtocol, attackValue)
L163: This is unlikely to occur outside of a contrived scenario.
L164: ### Patches
L165: 
L166: The problem is resolved in v5.9.2.
L167: 
L168: ### Workarounds
L169: 
L170: Do not use the simple protocol to execute queries matching all the above conditions.
L171: 
L172: ### Severity
L173: 
L174: Moderate
L175: 
L176: ### CVE ID
L177: 
L178: CVE-2026-41889
L179:

L206: 	//   "p=tls-server-end-point,," - channel binding is active via SCRAM-SHA-256-PLUS

L209: 	//   https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5802#section-6

L4: SQL injection can occur when:
L5: 
L6: 1. The non-default simple protocol is used.
L7: 2. A dollar quoted string literal is used in the SQL query.
L8: 3. That query contains text that would be would be interpreted outside as a placeholder outside of a string literal.

L10: 
L11: e.g.

L14: _, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `select $tag$ $1 $tag$, $1`, pgx.QueryExecModeSimpleProtocol, attackValue)
L15: ```
L16: 
L17: This is unlikely to occur outside of a contrived scenario.
